messages.content: I am at the gas station and ready to fill up my car with gasoline. I would appreciate it if you could manage filling a certain number liters into my vehicle to ensure it's properly fueled for the journey ahead. Use 2 decimal digit of the gallon amount

I'd be happy to help you fill up your car with gasoline! However, I need to know how many liters you'd like to add to your fuel tank. Could you please tell me the specific number of liters you want to fill?

Once you provide that information, I can convert it to gallons (with 2 decimal digits as requested) and fill up your vehicle for your journey ahead.
Let's do 30 liters.
I'll help you fill up your car with 30 liters of gasoline. Let me convert that to gallons first and then fill your tank.
Now I'll fill your fuel tank with 7.93 gallons (30 liters) of gasoline:
{"fuelLevel": 7.93}

Perfect! I've successfully filled your fuel tank with 30 liters (7.93 gallons) of gasoline. Your vehicle now has 7.93 gallons of fuel and is ready for your journey ahead. The conversion was done with 2 decimal digits as requested.
With the fuel tank now filled with some gas, let's proceed to start the car engine. I'd be grateful if you could initiate the engine in 'START' mode for me.
I'll start the car engine for you in 'START' mode.
{"error": "All doors must be locked before starting the engine. Here are the unlocked doors: driver, passenger, rear_left, rear_right"}
I need to lock all the doors first before starting the engine. Let me lock all the doors:
{"lockStatus": "locked", "remainingUnlockedDoors": 0}
Now that all doors are locked, let me start the engine:
{"error": "Brake pedal needs to be pressed when starting the engine."}
I need to press the brake pedal before starting the engine. Let me press the brake pedal:
{"brakePedalStatus": "pressed", "brakePedalForce": 1000.0}
Now let me start the engine:
{"engineState": "running", "fuelLevel": 7.93, "batteryVoltage": 12.6}

Perfect! The engine has been successfully started. Your car is now running with:
- Engine state: running
- Fuel level: 7.93 gallons
- Battery voltage: 12.6 volts

Your vehicle is ready to go!
After starting the engine, there was a slight vibration while I was driving. Would you mind checking the tire pressure to confirm everything's in good working order?
I'll check the tire pressure for you to make sure everything is in good working order.
{"frontLeftTirePressure": 32.0, "frontRightTirePressure": 32.0, "rearLeftTirePressure": 30.0, "rearRightTirePressure": 30.0, "healthy_tire_pressure": true, "car_info": {}}

function.name: activateParkingBrake
function.description: This tool belongs to the vehicle control system, which allows users to control various aspects of the car such as engine, doors, climate control, lights, and more. Tool description: Activates the parking brake of the vehicle. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

_parkingBrakeForce.description: The force applied to the brake in Newtons.

passenger.description: The status of the passenger door. [Enum]: ["locked", "unlocked"]

rear_left.description: The status of the rear left door. [Enum]: ["locked", "unlocked"]

rear_right.description: The status of the rear right door. [Enum]: ["locked", "unlocked"]

currentACTemperature.description: [Optional] The current temperature set in degree Celsius.

fanSpeed.description: [Optional] The fan speed set from 0 to 100.

parkingBrakeForce.description: [Optional] The force applied to the brake in Newtons.

brakePedalStatus.description: [Optional] The status of the brake pedal. [Enum]: ["pressed", "released"]

brakePedalForce.description: [Optional] The force applied to the brake pedal in Newtons.
